root_cause: The decrement of the loop counter `i` within a nested loop alongside the decrement of `N` causes the outer loop to potentially run indefinitely or skip necessary iterations. The decrement of `i` should be managed such that it's correctly reset to ensure the proper continuation of the outer loop.
suggestion:
Suggestion 1. Reset Loop Counter Instead of decrementing `i`, reset `i` to -1 so that it becomes 0 in the next iteration of the outer loop. This ensures the outer loop runs correctly without skipping necessary iterations.
```java
i = -1;
```
